pokedex.1: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. The plant sprouts and grows with this POKéMON.
pokedex.2: When the bulb on its back grows large, it appears to lose the ability to stand on its hind legs.
pokedex.3: The plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.
pokedex.4: Obviously prefers hot places. When it rains, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.
pokedex.5: When it swings its burning tail, it elevates the temperature to unbearably high levels.
pokedex.6: Spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. Known to cause forest fires unintentionally.
pokedex.7: After birth, its back swells and hardens into a shell. Powerfully sprays foam from its mouth.
pokedex.8: Often hides in water to stalk unwary prey. For swimming fast, it moves its ears to maintain balance.
pokedex.9: A brutal POKéMON with pressurized water jets on its shell. They are used for high speed tackles.
pokedex.10: When attacked by bird Pokémon, it resists by releasing a terrifically strong odor from its antennae, but it often becomes their prey.
pokedex.11: Its shell is filled with its soft innards. It doesn’t move much because of the risk it might carelessly spill its innards out.
pokedex.12: Close examination of its large eyes reveals that each eye is composed of a myriad of tiny eyes.
pokedex.13: Often found in forests, eating leaves. It has a sharp venomous stinger on its head.
pokedex.14: Almost incapable of moving, this POKéMON can only harden its shell to protect itself from predators.
pokedex.15: Flies at high speed and attacks using its large venomous stingers on its forelegs and tail.
pokedex.17: Very protective of its sprawling territorial area, this POKéMON will fiercely peck at any intruder.
pokedex.18: When hunting, it skims the surface of water at high speed to pick off unwary prey such as MAGIKARP.
pokedex.19: Its incisors continue growing until its death. If its Trainer doesn’t offer it a file to gnaw on, it will gnaw on door frames, table legs, and so on.
pokedex.20: Its hind feet are webbed, so it’s a strong swimmer. It can cross rivers and sometimes even oceans.
pokedex.21: Its short wings make it inept at flying. It moves about hurriedly and pecks at Bug-type Pokémon in the tall grass.
pokedex.22: It’s tough and has excellent stamina. It has no problem flying continuously for a whole day carrying a heavy load.
pokedex.23: By dislocating its jaw, it can swallow prey larger than itself. After a meal, it curls up and rests.
pokedex.24: The latest research has determined that there are over 20 possible arrangements of the patterns on its stomach.
pokedex.25: A plan was recently announced to gather many Pikachu and make an electric power plant.
pokedex.26: It unleashes electric shocks that can reach 100,000 volts. When agitated, it can knock out even an Indian elephant.
pokedex.27: It can roll its body into a ball. It moves through the desert by rolling at high speeds.
pokedex.28: Although they are sharp, its claws and spikes often break off. They grow back the next day, so it is not bothered by the temporary loss.
pokedex.29: Although small, its venomous barbs render this POKéMON dangerous. The female has smaller horns.
pokedex.30: The female's horn develops slowly. Prefers physical attacks such as clawing and biting.
pokedex.31: Its hard scales provide strong protection. It uses its hefty bulk to execute powerful moves.
pokedex.32: Stiffens its ears to sense danger. The larger its horns, the more powerful its secreted venom.
pokedex.33: An aggressive POKéMON that is quick to attack. The horn on its head secretes a powerful venom.
pokedex.34: It uses its powerful tail in battle to smash, constrict, then break the prey's bones.
pokedex.35: Its adorable behavior and appearance make it popular with men and women, young and old. Its numbers are few, however.
pokedex.36: They don’t like to reveal themselves in front of people. They live quietly in packs deep in the mountains.
pokedex.37: Its beautiful fur and tails have made it very popular. As it grows, its tails split to form more tails.
pokedex.38: Legend has it that this mystical Pokémon was formed when nine saints coalesced into one.
pokedex.39: It hugely inflates its stomach and sings a mysterious melody. If you hear this melody, you’ll become sleepy right away.
pokedex.40: It sheds its fine fur when the seasons change. The fur is gathered and spun into a luxurious yarn.
pokedex.41: It sleeps in caves during the day. It has no eyes, so to check its surroundings while flying, it emits ultrasonic waves.
pokedex.42: Its thick fangs are hollow like straws, making them unexpectedly fragile. These fangs are specialized for sucking blood.
pokedex.46: No matter how much it eats, the mushrooms growing on its back steal away most of the nutrients it consumes.
pokedex.47: The large mushroom on its back controls it. It often fights over territory with Shiinotic.
pokedex.48: Lives in the shadows of tall trees where it eats insects. It is attracted by light at night.
pokedex.49: The dust-like scales covering its wings are color coded to indicate the kinds of poison it has.
pokedex.50: It chews on plant roots underground. Farmers whose vegetables are vulnerable find it can be quite a pest.
pokedex.51: This set of triplets moves cooperatively. It’s the power of teamwork that enables this Pokémon to dig to a depth of 60 miles.
pokedex.52: It lies around all day, becoming active near dusk. At night, it wanders the city in search of loose change.
pokedex.53: It has a violent temperament. It will attack anything that looks it in the eye. Its sharp claws inflict deep wounds.
pokedex.54: As a result of headaches so fierce they cause it to cry, it sometimes uses psychokinesis without meaning to.
pokedex.55: It is said that the red part of its forehead grants supernatural powers to those who possess one, so it was over-hunted in the past.
pokedex.56: It can spontaneously become enraged. Everyone near it clears out as it rampages, and the resulting loneliness makes it angrier still.
pokedex.57: It has been known to become so angry that it dies as a result. Its face looks peaceful in death, however.
pokedex.58: It’s both clever and loyal, but if a stranger tries to invade its territory, it barks threateningly.
pokedex.59: Overflowing with beauty and majesty, this strong Pokémon appears in ancient Eastern folklore.
pokedex.60: The swirl on its belly is its internal organs showing through. If the swirl is tinged white, that means it’s affected by some disease.
pokedex.61: Although it can live on land, it prefers to stay in the water, where it has fewer natural enemies.
pokedex.62: Poliwrath in the Alola region are strong swimmers that use the breaststroke. Many children learn to swim by imitating Poliwrath.
pokedex.63: It sleeps 18 hours a day. Even while sleeping, it will teleport itself to treetops and pick and eat berries there.
pokedex.64: A theory exists that this Pokémon was a young boy who couldn’t control his psychic powers and ended up transformed into this Pokémon.
pokedex.65: It is said to have an IQ of approximately 5,000. Its overflowing psychokinetic powers cause headaches to anyone nearby.
pokedex.66: It loves working out. As it gazes at its muscles, which continue to swell day by day, it becomes more and more dedicated to its training.
pokedex.67: As a result of its continual workouts, it has developed tremendous power. It uses that power to help people with their work.
pokedex.68: It unleashes megaton-level punches that send opponents flying clear over the horizon.
pokedex.69: A carnivorous POKéMON that traps and eats bugs. It uses its root feet to soak up needed moisture.
pokedex.70: It spits out POISONPOWDER to immobilize the enemy and then finishes it with a spray of ACID.
pokedex.72: They can be found lying dehydrated on beaches, but they are often still alive. When soaked in water, they will revive.
pokedex.73: Normally, it has 80 poisonous tentacles. The longer one has been alive, the fewer tentacles it will have.
pokedex.74: Its round body makes it easy to pick up, but it is hard and heavy. It’s dangerous to play with them as if they were snowballs.
pokedex.75: Mossy rocks are its favorite food. It can devour a ton a day while crunching loudly.
pokedex.76: Its body can survive dynamite blasts without a single scratch, but it hates rain and humidity.
pokedex.77: Its hooves are 10 times harder than diamonds. It can trample anything completely flat in little time.
pokedex.78: Very competitive, this POKéMON will chase anything that moves fast in the hopes of racing it.
pokedex.79: Its long tail often breaks off. It doesn’t really feel any pain, though, and the tail grows back, so Slowpoke isn’t particularly bothered.
pokedex.80: It spaces out while gazing at the sea. With Shellder’s poison flowing through its body, it becomes even spacier.
pokedex.81: They gather in places where electricity is available. They can be found clinging to the steel towers used to support power lines.
pokedex.82: When three Magnemite link together, their brains also become one. They do not become three times more intelligent.
pokedex.83: The sprig of green onions it holds is its weapon. It is used much like a metal sword.
pokedex.84: A bird that makes up for its poor flying with its fast foot speed. Leaves giant footprints.
pokedex.85: Uses its three brains to execute complex plans. While two heads sleep, one head stays awake.
pokedex.86: It has always been supposed that Seel live only in cold seas. Their having shown up in Alola is a mystery.
pokedex.87: It swims through the ocean at a speed of eight knots, searching for Pokémon that will become its prey. It’s especially fond of Wishiwashi.
pokedex.88: Its main source of food is the slimy industrial waste of factories. This Pokémon’s numbers have been decreasing in recent years.
pokedex.89: The stench it gives off will make your nose scrunch up. Still, there are Muk fans who think that’s a good thing.
pokedex.90: The hardness of its shell surpasses the hardness of a diamond. In days gone by, people used the shells to make shields.
pokedex.91: Its hard shell cannot be shattered—not even by a bomb. The contents of the shell remain unknown.
pokedex.92: Should a strange light be seen flickering in an abandoned building, Gastly is lurking there.
pokedex.93: It strikes at humans from total darkness. Those licked by its cold tongue grow weaker with each passing day until they die.
pokedex.94: Should you feel yourself attacked by a sudden chill, it is evidence of an approaching Gengar. There is no escaping it. Give up.
pokedex.95: As it grows, the stone portions of its body harden to become similar to a diamond, but colored black.
pokedex.96: A Pokémon that nourishes itself by eating dreams, it is thought to share common ancestry with Munna and Musharna.
pokedex.97: While it is an extremely dangerous Pokémon, people who are in need of a good, sound sleep call it their savior.
pokedex.98: Its pincers are not only powerful weapons, they are used for balance when walking sideways.
pokedex.99: The large pincer has 10000 hp of crushing power. However, its huge size makes it unwieldy to use.
pokedex.100: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a POKé BALL, they have zapped many people.
pokedex.101: It stores electric energy under very high pressure. It often explodes with little or no provocation.
pokedex.102: Its six eggs use telepathy to communicate among themselves. It is believed to carry plant genes and the genes of other species.
pokedex.103: Each of its heads has its own will. They use telepathy to discuss their plans before coming to a joint decision.
pokedex.104: When it thinks of its deceased mother, it weeps loudly. Mandibuzz that hear its cries will attack it from the air.
pokedex.105: Originally, it was weak and timid. After evolution, its temperament becomes violent, and it begins to wield bones as weapons.
